slides.title: Stop Learning Cybersecurity Alone
slides.subtitle: Your community is your career multiplier

bullets: Join a CTF team - you'll learn 10x faster
Post your wins and your fails online
Follow people 1-2 steps ahead of you
Show up in Discord, not just LinkedIn

caption: Solo studying feels safe - but it's the slowest path into cyber. The people who break in fastest build in public and surround themselves with the right crowd. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #community #cypherjobs #networking
